subject: Does R Studio server and Shiny server work together?

messages.author: a723b5cb8d28f043
messages.subject: Does R Studio server and Shiny server work together?
parts:
Hi, we currently have an R Studio server installed so certain people can log into our system and use R. My question is can we install Shiny server as well, or will it interfere with people accessing the R Studio workspace?

Thank you.

messages.author: e2fa633be03afd47
messages.subject: Re: Does R Studio server and Shiny server work together?
parts:
I have both loaded on the same linux box and I haven't had any issues. In fact I'm often logged onto both at the same time and haven't
seen any interference issues.
